card.name: Linking words before blood pressure conditions
card.fires_on: The word "with" right after "patients" when a hypertension or heart failure condition comes next. Also "in" after a mm Hg rise before "systolic pressure".

modes.label: Patients with hypertension
modes.description: The word "with" after "patients" just before hypertension or heart failure wording.
modes.example: Do not initiate GAVRETO in patients<< with>> uncontrolled hypertension.

modes.label: Rise in blood pressure
modes.description: The word "in" after a mm Hg increase, leading into systolic pressure.
modes.example: patients treated with ZEPOSIA had an average increase of approximately 1 to 2 mm Hg<< in>> systolic pressure over patients who received IF

card.writes: It boosts words meaning hazard or risk, suggesting the next words name a cardiovascular risk or condition.
card.plain: It fires on the small linking word just before a blood pressure or heart failure condition is named.
